classificationMethod: Require exact pinned file hash plus upstream line history. For these 32 inputs the parsed blame origins are WebKit repository paths or line commits with no recovered previous path; no KHTML/KJS path or other source-project path appears in these 32 blame results. Earliest visible commits are all 2013 or later (some inspector data entered via the 2013 split from WebCore Inspector.json). On that bounded evidence, maintainer classifies these inputs BSD-2-Clause as WebKit contributions. No legal opinion; if further source evidence identifies an imported third-party origin, revoke the affected row and reassess.
